note: Names for the community-tag groups. 'overlay' = model_written names (worded from the tag's Scryfall description and the members' text; nothing claims the tag is verified). 'user_edits' = names edited by the user; they override the overlay and the fixed rules (src/tag_layer_names.py), which name everything not listed (name_source rule). 'vocabulary_allow' = plain-English words the vocabulary check would flag (it flags words found in no card text; these are ordinary words in model-written names).

overlay.symmetrical: Affects every player or the whole battlefield equally
overlay.alternative-cost: Can be cast for an alternative cost
overlay.digital-only-mechanics: Uses a mechanic made for Magic Arena
overlay.noncreature-typal: Cares about creature types (on a card that is not a creature)
overlay.cheaper-than-mv: Costs less than its mana value
overlay.pure-draw: Draws cards with no other cost
overlay.sweeper: Destroys everything of a kind (board wipe)
overlay.repeatable-pure-draw: Draws a card again and again with no other cost
overlay.multiplayer: Interacts with all the players in a game
overlay.cast-on-resolution: Casts spells as part of its own resolution
overlay.more-expensive-than-mv: Costs more than its mana value
overlay.saboteur: Triggers when it deals damage to an opponent
overlay.protects-self: Protects itself from being targeted or removed
overlay.mana-sink: Turns spare mana into a repeatable effect
overlay.reanimate-creature: Returns creature cards from the graveyard to the battlefield
overlay.discard-outlet: Lets you discard your own cards
overlay.gives-castable-from-exile: Lets you cast cards from exile
overlay.damage-prevention-creature: Stops or redirects damage to a creature
overlay.aikido: Turns an opponent's strength against them
overlay.multiple-bodies: Puts two or more creatures onto the battlefield at once
overlay.delayed-replacement-effect: A replacement effect that applies later
overlay.shapesharing: Becomes a copy of something else
overlay.punisher: Gives an opponent a choice of two bad options
overlay.mana-increaser: Increases the mana other permanents produce
overlay.consult-cast: Exiles cards until it finds one to cast (cascade, discover)
overlay.minigame: Plays a bet or guessing game with other players
overlay.keyword-anthem: Gives your whole team a keyword
overlay.universal-type-change: Turns all of one kind of thing into another (for example all lands into creatures)
overlay.damage-prevention-self: Stops or redirects damage to itself
overlay.pseudo-fog: Protects you from a whole combat
overlay.power-boost-to-all: Raises the power of your creatures (all of them, or a type)
overlay.castable-from-graveyard: Can be cast from the graveyard
overlay.multi-land-ramp: Puts two or more lands onto the battlefield
overlay.sweeper-one-sided: Board wipe that is, or can be, one-sided
overlay.martyr: Creature that sacrifices itself for a benefit
overlay.land-ramp: Puts more lands onto the battlefield
overlay.toughness-boost-to-all: Raises the toughness of all your creatures
overlay.land-conversion: Changes land types or what lands produce
overlay.mana-dork: Creature that makes mana again and again
overlay.mass-land-denial: Land denial: takes many lands away or keeps them tapped
overlay.removal-tuck: Puts a permanent into its owner's library
overlay.single-minded-color-hate: Works only against a specific color
overlay.bottomless-mana-sink: Uses any amount of mana for a bigger effect
overlay.consult-onto-battlefield: Looks through cards and puts the one it finds onto the battlefield
overlay.refund: Gives mana or untapped lands back
overlay.donate-token: Creates tokens under an opponent's control
overlay.self-discard-matters: Rewards you for discarding your own cards
overlay.hatebear: Cheap creature that works against a strategy
overlay.repeatable-sacrifice-outlet: Lets you sacrifice permanents again and again
overlay.single-minded-hate: Works only against one kind of opponent
overlay.pinger: Deals 1 or 2 damage again and again
overlay.reanimate-cast: Casts a permanent spell from a graveyard
overlay.reflexive-trigger: Triggers from an action earlier in the same ability
overlay.turn-face-up-trigger-self: Triggers when it is turned face up
overlay.reanimate-from-any: Returns a card from any graveyard
overlay.damage-prevention-player: Halves or redirects damage to players and creatures
overlay.typal-coupling: Cares about two or more creature types
overlay.removal-bounce: Removal: returns a permanent to its owner's hand
overlay.cost-increaser: Makes spells or abilities cost more
overlay.reanimate-permanent: Uses permanent cards in the graveyard (bring them back, cast them or alter them)
overlay.gives-castable-from-graveyard: Lets you cast cards from the graveyard
overlay.polymorph: Replaces a permanent with a random one
overlay.lobotomy: Exiles all cards with a chosen name
overlay.peek-hand: Finds out what is in a player's hand
overlay.quadratic: Effect grows with the square of a number
overlay.fog-selective: Stops or redirects damage from some sources only
overlay.mill-self: Puts cards from your library into your graveyard
overlay.tutored-by-name: Is found by another card naming it
overlay.full-refund: Gives back at least the mana it cost
overlay.cost-reducer-instant-sorcery: Makes instants and sorceries cost less
overlay.reanimate-artifact: Returns an artifact card from the graveyard to the battlefield
overlay.synergy-haste: Cares about haste (often in a list of keywords)
overlay.synergy-party: Cares about the party (Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard)
overlay.scry-like: Looks at the top card of a library to compare or use it (clash and similar)
overlay.remove-from-stack: Ends the turn or takes a spell off the stack
overlay.mill-opponent: Uses cards from the top of an opponent's library
overlay.tutor-land-to-battlefield: Searches for a land and puts it onto the battlefield
overlay.tutor-to-battlefield: Searches for a card and puts it onto the battlefield
overlay.tutor-to-hand: Searches for a card and puts it into your hand
overlay.tutors-by-name: Searches for a card by name
overlay.copy-legendary: Copies a legendary permanent or works around the legend rule
overlay.unblocked-trigger: Triggers when a creature attacks and is not blocked
overlay.out-of-color-token: Creates tokens of a color the card is not
overlay.removal-permanent: Takes permanents away from players, often at random or for everyone
overlay.protects-creature: Protects creatures, or works around their protection
